units.translation: The sea wave roars as it falls together, and the deep groans.
For many desires fall together into one.

by tmesis. Which Triclinius explains as ἤγουν μεταδιδόναι μοι τοῦ τοιούτου, ἤτοι τῆς χαρᾶς [that is, to give me a share of such a thing, namely of the joy]. Another example of this verb is in Pseudo-Chrysostom, Sermon 89, vol. 7, p. 519, 35: καὶ τοῦ σωτῆρος τὸν τόκον ἐπλούτησε καὶ αὐτὴ συνεπλουτίσθη τῇ χάριτι [and she enriched the offspring of the Savior and was herself enriched together with grace].
It is likely that these matters concern the house and Clytemnestra most of all, and that they enrich me along with them.

The words are corrupt. Markscheffel rightly changed τύχαν [fortune] to τάχ᾽ ἂν [perhaps], Hermann changed γυναικῶν [of women] to γυναικί [for a woman]. Weil conjectured τάχ᾽ ἂν γυναικῶν ταῦτα συμπρέποι στολῇ [perhaps these things would be fitting for the dress of women].
in the verse of the interpolator: each having the season in which it is fitting.
the fortune of women is fitting for these things.

which the scholiast explains by συμφωνήσει [will agree].
about to clash with each other: they will bring together hostile gods on their shields.
You must bring together faithful counsels with faithful ones for these deeds.
I will bring my passions together with yours; for you are older.
It is expedient to be prudent under constraint.
These things would be advantageous for us.
Only this will the land of Hellas agree upon with the aim.
For this house is never left by a chorus that sounds together, not melodious.
More often it is said of a sad event or calamity.
for the sake of this event.
But may you prosper, and may a gracious god watch over you and guard you with favorable events.
so that this company of the land may be gracious and distinguished by events with good men for the future.
For we will set right the fortunes of the one who reveres.
If you revere my sojourn, you will not blame the fortunes of life.
Your misfortune, Prometheus, is a teacher.
Do you also blame me for some misfortune?
But if, which may it not happen, some misfortune should befall.
Tell me what misfortune you say came upon the army of evils.
